tree.heading: Advanced communications service
tree.text: The term “advanced communications service” has the meaning given the term “advanced telecommunications capability” in section 1302 of this title.

tree.heading: Appropriate national security agency
tree.text: The term “appropriate national security agency” means—

children.text: the Office of the Director of National Intelligence;

tree.heading: Commission
tree.text: The term “Commission” means the Federal Communications Commission.

tree.heading: Communications equipment or service
tree.text: The term “communications equipment or service” means any equipment or service that is essential to the provision of advanced communications service.

tree.heading: Covered communications equipment or service
tree.text: The term “covered communications equipment or service” means any communications equipment or service that is on the list published by the Commission under section 1601(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Customers
tree.text: The term “customers” means, with respect to a provider of advanced communications service—

children.text: the customers of such provider; and
the customers of any affiliate (as defined in section 153 of this title) of such provider.

tree.heading: Executive branch interagency body
tree.text: The term “executive branch interagency body” means an interagency body established in the executive branch.

tree.heading: Person
tree.text: The term “person” means an individual or entity.

tree.heading: Program
tree.text: The term “Program” means the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Reimbursement Program established under section 1603(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Provider of advanced communications service
tree.text: The term “provider of advanced communications service”—

children.text: means a person who provides advanced communications service to United States customers; and

accredited public or private noncommercial educational institutions, providing their own facilities-based educational broadband service, as defined in section 27.4 of title 47, Code of Federal Regulations, or any successor regulation; and
health care providers and libraries providing advanced communications service.

tree.heading: Recipient
tree.text: The term “recipient” means any provider of advanced communications service the application of which for a reimbursement under the Program has been approved by the Commission, regardless of whether the provider has received reimbursement funds.

tree.heading: Reimbursement funds
tree.text: The term “reimbursement funds” means any reimbursement received under the Program.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2020—Par. (10). Pub. L. 116–260 amended par. (10) generally. Prior to amendment, text read as follows: “The term ‘provider of advanced communications service’ means a person who provides advanced communications service to United States customers.”
